title: 第14章 月试开始第15章 秒
lines: 天刚蒙蒙亮，江家上下便开始忙碌了起来，一些在外历练的家族子弟也在这一天纷纷回到家族中，因为对于他们而言，月试是每个月来最重要的日子。
月试主要设在外府，其目的自然是为家族选择最为优秀的子弟，只有通过月试的子弟，才有资格在江家主府继续修行，并获得大量的修炼资源。
而在月试中排名最后百名，则会被遣返回去原来的小镇，碌碌无为一生。
为了这一天，江玄已经准备了足足一个月。
此时，他来到了演武场，就见往日还算颇为宽敞的演武场，此时显得有些拥挤。
而那一个个江家子弟眼神中都是带着些许的亢奋，等待着月试的开始。
忽然在一处位置，江玄听到他们似乎在议论些什么。
“诶！你们听说了没，据说那血魔曹枫竟然被人给杀了！”
“什么？
你说的是真的吗？”
“这还有假，据说那血魔曹枫可是真元境三重的实力，真不知道是哪位高人所为，竟然能够镇杀得了这般狠人！”
“是啊！日后若是能够见一见这位高人，可真是三生有幸啊！”
“对！我以后就要以他为目标，努力成为一个绝世高手！”
“噗嗤！”
江玄听到众人的话，终于忍不住的一笑。
众人听到笑声，顿时一个个愤怒的转过头来，当他们见到来人时，脸上不由得出现了一抹嘲讽之色。
“废物，你笑什么？”
“别以为你打败了江幻，就可以趾高气扬。
告诉你，在江家外府打败一个排名第七的可不算什么本事！”
江玄见到众人那副嘲讽的面色，淡然说道。
“如果说这一次我不止想要打败江幻，我还想夺得月试的第一呢！”
闻言，那些嘲讽他的人顿时愣住了，那副模样就像是在看一个傻子一般。
“哈哈哈哈”那几位江家排名前几的子弟更是纷纷大笑了起来，仿佛这是天底下最好笑的笑话。
“江玄，我看你是最近一直风生水起，都忘了自己的身份了吧！”
“江玄，你这么厉害，你还不如说你便是那击败了血魔曹枫的绝世高人呢！这样我们或许就会相信了呢”“哈哈哈！这怎么可能？”
说完，他们纷纷哈哈发现了起来，显然把江玄当成了疯子。
江玄摇了摇头，直接转身离开，这年头说句实话怎么就没人相信呢？
而在他们这边议论的时候，江家内的许多大人物也是纷纷来到了高台上。
“那便是的江家家主江天吗？”
江玄的目光扫过了高台上那位于中央位置的那名中年男子，喃喃自语。
而就在这时，在那远处又有着许多的强者纷纷赶到，只见其中不少有来自大家族的重要人物。
忽然，江玄的目光忽然在一名少女的身上停了下来，只见那名少女今日身着紫色的长裙，灵动双眸正巧笑嫣然的望着自己。
“云曦！”
他没想到，这个丫头竟然也来了！“江玄，这一次我可是费了好大的功夫才让爹爹同意我来这里的呢！你可一定要加油啊！”
content_en:
As soon as it dawned, the Jiang family began to get busy. Some of the family members who were practicing abroad also returned to the family on this day, because for them, the monthly examination is the most important day of every month.
The monthly examination is mainly held in the outer palace, and its purpose is naturally to select the best disciples for the family. Only the disciples who pass the monthly examination are qualified to continue practicing in the main palace of the Jiang family and obtain a large amount of training resources.
Those who rank among the bottom 100 in the monthly exam will be sent back to their original town to live a life of mediocrity.
Jiang Xuan has been preparing for this day for a full month.
At this time, he arrived at the martial arts arena and saw that the martial arts arena, which was quite spacious in the past, now seemed a bit crowded.
And all the Jiang family disciples had a little excitement in their eyes, waiting for the monthly examination to begin.
Suddenly, Jiang Xuan heard them discussing something at a certain location.
"Hey! Have you heard? It is said that the blood demon Cao Feng was actually killed!"
"What?
Is what you say true? "
"This is still false. It is said that the blood demon Cao Feng is at the third level of the True Yuan Realm. I really don't know which master is responsible for this, but he can actually kill such a ruthless person!"
"Yes! If I can meet this master in the future, I will be truly lucky!"
"Yes! I will take him as my goal in the future and strive to become a peerless master!"
"Pfft!"
Jiang Xuan finally couldn't help but smile when he heard everyone's words.
"Huh?"
When everyone heard the laughter, they immediately turned their heads angrily. When they saw the person coming, they couldn't help but have a look of ridicule on their faces.
"Trash, why are you laughing?"
"Don't think that just because you defeated Jiang Huan, you can be arrogant.
Let me tell you, defeating a seventh-ranked person in the Jiang Family's Foreign Mansion is no big deal! "
Jiang Xuan saw the mocking looks on everyone's face and said calmly.
"If this time I not only want to defeat Jiang Huan, I also want to win the first place in the monthly test!"
Hearing this, those who were mocking him were stunned, as if they were looking at a fool.
"Hahahaha" the top few Jiang family disciples burst out laughing, as if this was the funniest joke in the world.
"Jiang Xuan, I think you have been so prosperous recently that you have forgotten your identity!"
"Jiang Xuan, you are so powerful, you might as well say that you are the peerless expert who defeated the Blood Demon Cao Feng! Then maybe we will believe it." "Hahaha! How is this possible?"
After saying that, they all laughed and found out, obviously thinking Jiang Xuan was a madman.
Jiang Xuan shook his head, turned around and left. Why doesn't anyone believe him if he tells the truth these days?
While they were discussing, many important figures in the Jiang family also came to the high platform.
"Is that Jiang Tian, the head of the Jiang family?"
Jiang Xuan glanced at the middle-aged man in the center of the high platform and murmured to himself.
"Uh-huh!"
At this moment, many powerful people arrived in the distance, and many of them were important figures from big families.
"Eh!"
Suddenly, Jiang Xuan's eyes suddenly stopped on a girl. He saw that the girl was wearing a purple dress today, and her smart eyes happened to be looking at him with a smile.
"Yunxi!"
He didn't expect that this girl would come too! "Jiang Xuan, it took a lot of effort for me to get my father to agree to come here this time! You must work hard!"
title_en: Chapter 14 The monthly test begins Chapter 15 Seconds
